patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clearbit and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clearbit and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Clearbit only if your buying job matches “HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelli” rather than Hunter's shape. Choose Hunter only if your buying job matches “Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; St” rather than Clearbit's shape. Workflow advantage: Clearbit leans contact-management; Hunter leans prospecting, email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clearbit and Hunter share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clearbit is HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelligence — usage/credits via HubSpot, Starter+ requir; Hunter is Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; Starter from $49/mo..
- Company-size focus: Clearbit (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Hunter (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clearbit-leaning contact-management vs Hunter-leaning prospecting, email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Clearbit — Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; Hunter — Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database.

Limitations — Clearbit: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; No standalone free plan; typically needs HubSpot Starter+; Hunter: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database; Lead scoring is limited versus enterprise SI platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Clearbit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric · Hunter is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database · Avoid Clearbit if you actually need Hunter's motion (Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
